newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta to hold inquiry into security after hijack.
newsitem.headline: Malta to hold inquiry into security after hijack.

text.p: Maltese Prime Minister Alfred Sant told parliament on Monday an inquiry would be held into the security for an Air Malta flight that was hijacked on a flight to Istanbul and diverted to Cologne.
Sant said it was not clear if the two hijackers, who surrendered in Germany early on Monday, had dynamite as they claimed when they took over the flight with 80 people on board.
He said the flight was taken over some 20 minutes after leaving Malta by two Turkish men, one of whom sat on the front and the other at the back.
A Maltese magistrate is on his way to Germany to carry out an inquiry.
